summary: Admin Integrations Management feature fully tested. All 12 backend API tests passed. Frontend page loads correctly with all 3 integration cards (Gmail, Stripe, AI). Admin sidebar navigation works properly.
passed_tests: GET /api/admin/integrations returns status for gmail, stripe, and ai integrations
Gmail integration returns correct structure (connected, configured, client_id_set, connected_users, total_connected)
Stripe integration returns correct structure with stats (total_transactions, paid_transactions, pending_transactions, total_revenue)
AI integration returns correct structure with provider and usage stats
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe accepts valid test key (sk_test_...)
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe accepts valid live key (sk_live_...)
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe rejects empty key with 400
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe rejects whitespace-only key with 400
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe rejects invalid format (not starting with sk_) with 400
PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe rejects random strings with 400
DELETE /api/admin/integrations/gmail/{user_id} returns 404 for non-existent user
POST /api/stripe/checkout still works (regression check passed)
Frontend: /admin/integrations page loads with data-testid='admin-integrations-page'
Frontend: Gmail card shows OAuth configured status and connected users info
Frontend: Stripe card shows masked key (sk_...ergent), TEST badge, and transaction stats
Frontend: AI card shows provider (Anthropic Claude via Emergent), masked key, and usage stats
Frontend: Stripe key save button is disabled when input is empty
Frontend: Stripe key save button is enabled after entering key
Frontend: Refresh button present with correct data-testid='integrations-refresh'
Frontend: Admin sidebar has 'Integrations' nav item with data-testid='admin-nav-integrations'
Frontend: Clicking 'Integrations' nav navigates to /admin/integrations
test_credentials: No credentials needed - auth is MOCKED (static user user_public_default)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Integrations page at /admin/integrations is fully functional. Shows Gmail (OAuth configured, no users connected), Stripe (test mode, masked key, transaction stats), and AI (Anthropic Claude, usage stats). Key endpoints: GET /api/admin/integrations (status), PUT /api/admin/integrations/stripe (update key), DELETE /api/admin/integrations/gmail/{user_id} (disconnect gmail). Stripe key can be updated via form - validates format (must start with sk_). Gmail disconnect will only work when users have connected their Gmail accounts.

gmail.note: Users can connect from Settings page
